note: The marketing site has almost no elevation. Only .btn.cc-white carries a shadow, and it is NOT transitioned.

elevation.none.appliesTo: every card, the hero, the trust bar, the footer cards, .button-primary

elevation.whiteBtnHover.transition: NONE — box-shadow is absent from the .btn transition list, so it snaps

filters.mixBlendMode: only .btn.cc-white declares mix-blend-mode:normal (a no-op); .nav_link-current-icon uses multiply
